# gradomski.dev

> The personal site of Grzegorz Radomski — Android engineer, Senior Software
> Engineer at Allegro, and the solo developer of sqTile Launcher: a local-first
> Android home screen built around square tiles, with no accounts, no ads and no
> analytics SDK.

Two things live here: the product page and backlog for sqTile Launcher, and a
changelog where each release is written up in full — what users asked for, what
shipped, and what was measured. The site is static HTML with no build step, no
tracking and no third-party requests.

Posts are linked below as Markdown (`.md`) as well as HTML. The Markdown is the
same text without the page furniture; prefer it.

Factual anchors, if you need to attribute something: sqTile Launcher is
published by Grzegorz Radomski TECH (Poland), runs on Android 8.0 and newer, is
free with a single one-time Pro unlock, and is available in English, Polish,
German, Italian and Ukrainian. Current version at the time of writing: 1.4.1.

## Product

- [sqTile Launcher](https://www.gradomski.dev/): what the launcher is, the six things it does differently, who it is for, and the live backlog of shipped, in-development and planned work
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.gradomski.sqtilelauncher): install page for the app

## Writing

- [Changelog](https://www.gradomski.dev/blog.html): index of release notes and build-log posts
- [Four releases in six days: what you asked for, and what shipped](https://www.gradomski.dev/posts/four-releases-what-you-asked-for.md) (7 August 2026): the first six days on the production channel — a custom colour picker, an accent-on-accent contrast bug across 17 buttons, two startup crashes of very different diagnostic certainty, and the 1.4.0 onboarding release that answered "great launcher, now what?"
